# Load Data

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(easystats)

# Repository-relative location for the published analysis data.
data_dir <- file.path("..", "data")
library(flextable)
library(fixest)

# Set working directory to script location
if (requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE) && rstudioapi::isAvailable()) {
  doc_path <- rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path
  if (!is.null(doc_path) && nzchar(doc_path)) {
    setwd(dirname(doc_path))
  }
}

panel_complete <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "panel_data.csv"))

panel_complete <- panel_complete %>%
    mutate(
      # Create PR + Issue combined metric for month t
      prs_issues_combined_t = cumulative_prs_count_t + cumulative_issues_count_t,
      velocity_t = (cumulative_commits_count_t + cumulative_authors_t + prs_issues_combined_t) / 3
    )
  
t_plus_n_suffix <- "_t_plus_6"
# Calculate composite velocity score only if it's the target variable
vel_target_col     <- paste0("velocity",              t_plus_n_suffix)
prs_iss_target_col <- paste0("prs_issues_combined",   t_plus_n_suffix)

panel_complete[[prs_iss_target_col]] <-
  panel_complete[[paste0("cumulative_prs_count",   t_plus_n_suffix)]] +
  panel_complete[[paste0("cumulative_issues_count", t_plus_n_suffix)]]

panel_complete[[vel_target_col]] <-
  (panel_complete[[paste0("cumulative_commits_count", t_plus_n_suffix)]] +
   panel_complete[[paste0("cumulative_authors",        t_plus_n_suffix)]] +
   panel_complete[[prs_iss_target_col]]) / 3

```

# Residualized ST Score Models

```{r}

main_control_vars <- c(
  "cumulative_forks_t",
  "cumulative_stars_t",
  "age_in_months_t",
  # "issues_cr_still_open_t",
  # "prs_cr_still_open_t",
  "technical_supplier_count",
  "social_supplier_count"
)

main_target_vars <- c(
  "issues_tfr_mean_hours_t_plus_6",
  "prs_tfr_mean_hours_t_plus_6",
  "issues_ttc_mean_hours_t_plus_6",
  "prs_ttc_mean_hours_t_plus_6",
  "num_core_contributors_t_plus_6",
  "num_new_contributors_t_plus_6",
  "cumulative_authors_t_plus_6",
  "cumulative_commits_t_plus_6",
  "prs_issues_combined_t_plus_6",
  "velocity_t_plus_6"
)

st_score_vars <- c(
  st1 = "st1_supplier_coverage",
  st2 = "st2_developer_coverage",
  st3 = "st3_edge_density"
)

residualize_st_score <- function(data, st_var, residual_controls,
                                 entity_var = "repo_id",
                                 time_var = "month") {
  required_vars <- c(st_var, entity_var, time_var, residual_controls)
  missing_vars <- setdiff(required_vars, names(data))

  if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing variables for residualization: ",
      paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  data_with_id <- data %>%
    mutate(
      .row_id_resid = row_number(),
      .st_resid_lhs = log1p(.data[[st_var]]),
      across(
        all_of(residual_controls),
        ~ log1p(.x),
        .names = ".resid_ctrl_{.col}"
      )
    )

  resid_control_vars <- paste0(".resid_ctrl_", residual_controls)

  resid_df <- data_with_id %>%
    select(all_of(c(".row_id_resid", entity_var, time_var, ".st_resid_lhs", resid_control_vars))) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(c(".st_resid_lhs", resid_control_vars)), is.finite))

  if (nrow(resid_df) < 10L) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))
  }

  resid_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      ".st_resid_lhs ~ ",
      paste(resid_control_vars, collapse = " + "),
      " | ",
      entity_var,
      " + ",
      time_var
    )
  )

  resid_model <- tryCatch(
    feols(resid_formula, data = resid_df, vcov = "twoway", fixef.rm = "none"),
    error = function(e1) {
      tryCatch(
        feols(resid_formula, data = resid_df, vcov = "iid", fixef.rm = "none"),
        error = function(e2) {
          warning(
            "feols() failed while residualizing ", st_var,
            "; falling back to pooled OLS. feols error: ",
            conditionMessage(e1)
          )
          lm(
            as.formula(
              paste0(".st_resid_lhs ~ ", paste(resid_control_vars, collapse = " + "))
            ),
            data = resid_df
          )
        }
      )
    }
  )

  out <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))

  if (inherits(resid_model, "fixest")) {
    resid_values <- residuals(resid_model)

    if (length(resid_values) == nrow(resid_df)) {
      obs_kept <- seq_len(nrow(resid_df))
    } else {
      obs_removed <- sort(unique(abs(unlist(resid_model$obs_selection))))
      obs_kept <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(resid_df)), obs_removed)
    }

    out[resid_df$.row_id_resid[obs_kept]] <- resid_values
  } else {
    out[resid_df$.row_id_resid] <- residuals(resid_model)
  }

  out
}

panel_complete <- panel_complete %>%
  mutate(
    st1_resid = residualize_st_score(
      data = panel_complete,
      st_var = "st1_supplier_coverage",
      residual_controls = main_control_vars
    ),
    st2_resid = residualize_st_score(
      data = panel_complete,
      st_var = "st2_developer_coverage",
      residual_controls = main_control_vars
    ),
    st3_resid = residualize_st_score(
      data = panel_complete,
      st_var = "st3_edge_density",
      residual_controls = main_control_vars
    )
  )

summary(panel_complete %>% select(st1_resid, st2_resid, st3_resid))

control_rhs <- paste(paste0("log1p(", main_control_vars, ")"), collapse = " + ")

build_residualized_st_model <- function(target_var, st_resid_var,
                                        include_controls = TRUE) {
  rhs_terms <- c(
    st_resid_var,
    if (include_controls) control_rhs else NULL
  )

  feols(
    as.formula(
      paste0(
        "log1p(", target_var, ") ~ ",
        paste(rhs_terms, collapse = " + "),
        " | repo_id + month"
      )
    ),
    vcov = "twoway",
    data = panel_complete
  )
}

residualized_st_models <- lapply(main_target_vars, function(target_var) {
  list(
    st1_resid = build_residualized_st_model(target_var, "st1_resid"),
    st2_resid = build_residualized_st_model(target_var, "st2_resid"),
    st3_resid = build_residualized_st_model(target_var, "st3_resid")
  )
})

  )
})

  )

extract_resid_coef <- function(model, coef_name) {
  coef_table <- coeftable(model)

  if (!coef_name %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
    return(tibble(
      estimate = NA_real_,
      std_error = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  tibble(
    estimate = coef_table[coef_name, "Estimate"],
    std_error = coef_table[coef_name, "Std. Error"],
    p_value = coef_table[coef_name, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}

    extract_resid_coef(residualized_st_only_models[[target_var]]$st2_resid, "st2_resid") %>%
      mutate(target = target_var, model = "ST2 residualized only"),
    extract_resid_coef(residualized_st_only_models[[target_var]]$st3_resid, "st3_resid") %>%

      mutate(target = target_var, model = "All residualized ST: ST3"),
    extract_resid_coef(residualized_all_st_only_models[[target_var]], "st1_resid") %>%

      p_value < 0.1 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )
```

# Out-of-Sample R² (Leave-One-Repo-Out Cross-Validation)

```{r}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# OOS R² via Leave-One-Repo-Out (LORO) CV with within-entity demeaning
#
# Algorithm for each hold-out repo i:
#   1. Train the model on all repos j ≠ i  (two-way FE: repo_id + month)
#   2. Extract structural coefficients β from the trained model
#   3. For the hold-out repo, demean y and X by their own repo-level means,
#      which absorbs the unobserved entity FE without requiring a training
#      estimate of α_i
#   4. Predict:  ŷ_dm = X_dm · β
#   5. OOS residual:  e = y_dm − ŷ_dm
#
# Aggregate OOS R² = 1 − Σe² / Σy_dm²  (pooled across all hold-out repos)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

oos_r2_logo <- function(data,
                         target_var,
                         full_rhs,
                         entity_var = "repo_id",
                         time_var = "month") {

  repos <- sort(unique(data[[entity_var]]))
  if (length(repos) < 3L) return(NA_real_)

  full_formula <- as.formula(paste0("log1p(", target_var, ") ~ ", full_rhs))

  # Parse structural RHS (before the first "|") into individual terms
  struct_rhs <- trimws(strsplit(full_rhs, "\\|")[[1L]][1L])
  raw_terms  <- trimws(strsplit(struct_rhs, "\\+")[[1L]])
  beta_names <- raw_terms                                       # e.g. "log1p(x)"
  pred_vars  <- gsub("^log1p\\((.+)\\)$", "\\1", raw_terms)   # e.g. "x"

  missing_in_data <- setdiff(c(target_var, pred_vars, time_var), names(data))
  if (length(missing_in_data) > 0L) {
    warning("Variables not found in data: ",
            paste(missing_in_data, collapse = ", "))
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  all_e2   <- numeric(0)
  all_ydm2 <- numeric(0)

  for (repo in repos) {
    train_data <- data[data[[entity_var]] != repo, , drop = FALSE]
    test_data  <- data[data[[entity_var]] == repo, , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(test_data) < 2L) next

    # Fit on N−1 repos; iid vcov is sufficient (only point estimates needed)
    model <- tryCatch(
      feols(full_formula, data = train_data, vcov = "iid"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(model)) next

    # Extract coefficients in the order that matches beta_names
    beta <- tryCatch(coef(model)[beta_names], error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(beta) || anyNA(beta)) next

    # Build log1p-transformed y and X for the hold-out repo
    y_raw <- log1p(test_data[[target_var]])
    X_raw <- vapply(
      setNames(pred_vars, beta_names),
      function(v) log1p(test_data[[v]]),
      numeric(nrow(test_data))
    )
    # vapply returns a vector when nrow == 1; normalise to matrix
    if (!is.matrix(X_raw))
      X_raw <- matrix(X_raw, nrow = nrow(test_data),
                      dimnames = list(NULL, beta_names))

    valid <- is.finite(y_raw) & rowSums(!is.finite(X_raw)) == 0L
    if (sum(valid) < 2L) next

    y_test <- y_raw[valid]
    X_test <- X_raw[valid, , drop = FALSE]
    time_test <- test_data[[time_var]][valid]

    time_fe <- tryCatch(fixef(model)[[time_var]], error = function(e) NULL)
    time_hat <- rep(0, length(y_test))

    if (!is.null(time_fe)) {
      time_hat <- unname(time_fe[as.character(time_test)])
      valid_time <- is.finite(time_hat)

      if (sum(valid_time) < 2L) next

      y_test <- y_test[valid_time]
      X_test <- X_test[valid_time, , drop = FALSE]
      time_hat <- time_hat[valid_time]
    }

    # Within-entity demean — absorbs the unobserved entity fixed effect
    y_dm     <- y_test - mean(y_test)
    X_dm     <- sweep(X_test, 2L, colMeans(X_test), "-")
    # Center month FE so it is on the same held-out repo-demeaned scale.
    time_dm  <- time_hat - mean(time_hat)

    ypred_dm <- as.vector(X_dm %*% beta) + time_dm
    e        <- y_dm - ypred_dm

    all_e2   <- c(all_e2,   e^2)
    all_ydm2 <- c(all_ydm2, y_dm^2)
  }

  if (length(all_e2) == 0L || sum(all_ydm2) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  1 - sum(all_e2) / sum(all_ydm2)
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Model specifications (mirroring the main analysis)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

# ST1 and ST2 Within-R2 Incremental Explanatory Power

```{r}

extract_oos_rhs_parts <- function(full_rhs) {
  struct_rhs <- trimws(strsplit(full_rhs, "\\|")[[1L]][1L])
  raw_terms <- trimws(strsplit(struct_rhs, "\\+")[[1L]])
  pred_vars <- gsub("^log1p\\((.+)\\)$", "\\1", raw_terms)

  list(
    struct_rhs = struct_rhs,
    pred_vars = pred_vars
  )
}

build_same_sample_model_df <- function(data,
                                       target_var,
                                       full_rhs,
                                       entity_var = "repo_id",
                                       time_var = "month") {
  rhs_parts <- extract_oos_rhs_parts(full_rhs)
  required_vars <- unique(c(target_var, rhs_parts$pred_vars, entity_var, time_var))
  missing_vars <- setdiff(required_vars, names(data))

  if (length(missing_vars) > 0L) {
    stop("Variables not found in data: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))
  }

  data %>%
    select(all_of(required_vars)) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(log1p(.data[[target_var]])),
      if_all(all_of(rhs_parts$pred_vars), ~ is.finite(log1p(.x)))
    )
}

compute_within_r2_delta <- function(data,
                                    target_var,
                                    st_full_rhs,
                                    null_full_rhs,
                                    model_name,
                                    entity_var = "repo_id",
                                    time_var = "month") {
  model_df <- build_same_sample_model_df(
    data = data,
    target_var = target_var,
    full_rhs = st_full_rhs,
    entity_var = entity_var,
    time_var = time_var
  )

  if (nrow(model_df) < 10L) {
    return(tibble(
      target = target_var,
      model = model_name,
      n_obs = nrow(model_df),
      n_repo = n_distinct(model_df[[entity_var]]),
      n_month = n_distinct(model_df[[time_var]]),
      wr2_null = NA_real_,
      wr2_st = NA_real_,
      delta_wr2 = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  st_model <- tryCatch(
    feols(
      as.formula(paste0("log1p(", target_var, ") ~ ", st_full_rhs)),
      data = model_df,
      vcov = "iid"
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  null_model <- tryCatch(
    feols(
      as.formula(paste0("log1p(", target_var, ") ~ ", null_full_rhs)),
      data = model_df,
      vcov = "iid"
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(st_model) || is.null(null_model)) {
    return(tibble(
      target = target_var,
      model = model_name,
      n_obs = nrow(model_df),
      n_repo = n_distinct(model_df[[entity_var]]),
      n_month = n_distinct(model_df[[time_var]]),
      wr2_null = NA_real_,
      wr2_st = NA_real_,
      delta_wr2 = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  wr2_null <- unname(fixest::r2(null_model, type = "wr2"))
  wr2_st <- unname(fixest::r2(st_model, type = "wr2"))

  tibble(
    target = target_var,
    model = model_name,
    n_obs = nobs(st_model),
    n_repo = n_distinct(model_df[[entity_var]]),
    n_month = n_distinct(model_df[[time_var]]),
    wr2_null = wr2_null,
    wr2_st = wr2_st,
    delta_wr2 = wr2_st - wr2_null
  )
}

within_r2_incremental_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(main_target_vars, function(target) {
  bind_rows(
    compute_within_r2_delta(
      data = panel_complete,
      target_var = target,
      st_full_rhs = model_rhs_oos$st1,
      null_full_rhs = model_rhs_oos$null,
      model_name = "ST1"
    ),
    compute_within_r2_delta(
      data = panel_complete,
      target_var = target,
      st_full_rhs = model_rhs_oos$st2,
      null_full_rhs = model_rhs_oos$null,
      model_name = "ST2"
    )
  )
}))

within_r2_incremental_display <- within_r2_incremental_summary %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = str_remove(target, "_t_plus_6"),
    across(c(wr2_null, wr2_st, delta_wr2), ~ round(.x, 4))
  ) %>%
  select(outcome, model, n_obs, n_repo, n_month, wr2_null, wr2_st, delta_wr2)

print(within_r2_incremental_display)

flextable(within_r2_incremental_display) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    outcome = "Outcome",
    model = "Model",
    n_obs = "N",
    n_repo = "Repos",
    n_month = "Months",
    wr2_null = "Null Within R2",
    wr2_st = "ST Within R2",
    delta_wr2 = "Delta Within R2"
  ) %>%
  set_caption("Incremental within-repo R2 for ST1 and ST2 relative to same-sample null models") %>%
  colformat_double(digits = 4) %>%
  autofit()
```

# Within-R2 Reconciliation Diagnostics

```{r}

add_misq_composites <- function(data, suffix = "_t_plus_6") {
  prs_iss_col <- paste0("prs_issues_combined", suffix)
  vel_col <- paste0("velocity", suffix)
  prs_count_col <- paste0("cumulative_prs_count", suffix)
  issues_count_col <- paste0("cumulative_issues_count", suffix)
  commits_col <- paste0("cumulative_commits_count", suffix)
  authors_col <- paste0("cumulative_authors", suffix)

  if (!prs_iss_col %in% names(data) &&
      all(c(prs_count_col, issues_count_col) %in% names(data))) {
    data[[prs_iss_col]] <- data[[prs_count_col]] + data[[issues_count_col]]
  }

  if (!vel_col %in% names(data) &&
      all(c(commits_col, authors_col, prs_iss_col) %in% names(data))) {
    data[[vel_col]] <- (data[[commits_col]] + data[[authors_col]] + data[[prs_iss_col]]) / 3
  }

  data
}

count_within_r2_complete_cases <- function(data,
                                           target_var,
                                           st_var,
                                           control_rhs,
                                           entity_var = "repo_id",
                                           time_var = "month") {
  rhs_parts <- extract_oos_rhs_parts(paste0(control_rhs, " + log1p(", st_var, ") | ", entity_var, " + ", time_var))
  required_vars <- unique(c(target_var, rhs_parts$pred_vars, entity_var, time_var))

  if (!all(required_vars %in% names(data))) return(NA_integer_)

  data %>%
    select(all_of(required_vars)) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(log1p(.data[[target_var]])),
      if_all(all_of(rhs_parts$pred_vars), ~ is.finite(log1p(.x)))
    ) %>%
    nrow()
}

if (file.exists(file.path(data_dir, "predictive_dataset_6month_forward.csv"))) {
  socio_panel_for_reconciliation <- read_csv(
    file.path(data_dir, "predictive_dataset_6month_forward.csv"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    add_misq_composites(t_plus_n_suffix)

  within_r2_sample_reconciliation <- bind_rows(lapply(main_target_vars, function(target) {
    tibble(
      target = target,
      misq_panel_st1_n = count_within_r2_complete_cases(
        panel_complete, target, "st1_supplier_coverage", base_controls_oos
      ),
      socio_predictive_st1_n = count_within_r2_complete_cases(
        socio_panel_for_reconciliation, target, "st1_supplier_coverage", base_controls_oos
      ),
      misq_panel_st2_n = count_within_r2_complete_cases(
        panel_complete, target, "st2_developer_coverage", base_controls_oos
      ),
      socio_predictive_st2_n = count_within_r2_complete_cases(
        socio_panel_for_reconciliation, target, "st2_developer_coverage", base_controls_oos
      )
    )
  })) %>%
    mutate(
      target = str_remove(target, "_t_plus_6"),
      st1_n_difference = socio_predictive_st1_n - misq_panel_st1_n,
      st2_n_difference = socio_predictive_st2_n - misq_panel_st2_n
    )

  print(within_r2_sample_reconciliation)

  flextable(within_r2_sample_reconciliation) %>%
    set_header_labels(
      target = "Outcome",
      misq_panel_st1_n = "MISQ ST1 N",

} else {
```

# Correlation Between Within-R2 Delta and OOS Delta R2

```{r}

safe_cor <- function(x, y, method = "pearson") {
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)

  if (sum(keep) < 2L) return(NA_real_)
  if (sd(x[keep]) == 0 || sd(y[keep]) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  unname(cor(x[keep], y[keep], method = method))
}

      model == "ST2" ~ "within_delta_st2",
      TRUE ~ model
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = delta_wr2)

  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pearson_r = safe_cor(within_delta_wr2, oos_delta_r2, method = "pearson"),
    spearman_r = safe_cor(within_delta_wr2, oos_delta_r2, method = "spearman"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

within_oos_delta_correlations_pooled <- within_oos_delta_correlation_long %>%
  summarise(
    model = "ST1 + ST2 pooled",
    n = n(),
    pearson_r = safe_cor(within_delta_wr2, oos_delta_r2, method = "pearson"),
    spearman_r = safe_cor(within_delta_wr2, oos_delta_r2, method = "spearman")
  )

within_oos_delta_correlations <- bind_rows(
  within_oos_delta_correlations_by_model,
  within_oos_delta_correlations_pooled
) %>%
  mutate(across(c(pearson_r, spearman_r), ~ round(.x, 4)))

print(within_oos_delta_correlation_long)
print(within_oos_delta_correlations)

flextable(within_oos_delta_correlations) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    model = "Model",
    n = "N",
    pearson_r = "Pearson r",
    spearman_r = "Spearman rho"
  ) %>%
  set_caption("Correlation between incremental within-repo R2 and repo-held-out OOS delta R2") %>%
  colformat_double(digits = 4) %>%
  autofit()

```

# Recommended Repo-Held-Out TWFE OOS R2

```{r}

# This chunk makes the recommended OOS performance estimate explicit:
# leave one repo out, fit the two-way FE model on the remaining repos,
# predict held-out repo deviations from its own mean, and include the
# training-estimated month fixed effects centered within that held-out repo.

if (!exists("oos_r2_results")) {
  message("Computing recommended repo-held-out TWFE OOS R2 ...")

  oos_r2_results <- bind_rows(lapply(main_target_vars, function(target) {
    message("  Target: ", target)
    bind_cols(
      tibble(target = target),
      as_tibble(lapply(model_rhs_oos, function(rhs) {
        oos_r2_logo(data = panel_complete, target_var = target, full_rhs = rhs)
      }))
    )
  }))
}

recommended_repo_holdout_twfe_oos_r2 <- oos_r2_results

recommended_repo_holdout_twfe_display <- recommended_repo_holdout_twfe_oos_r2 %>%
  mutate(
    target = str_remove(target, "_t_plus_6"),
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))
  )

print(recommended_repo_holdout_twfe_display)

flextable(recommended_repo_holdout_twfe_display) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    target = "Outcome",
    null   = "Null",
    st1    = "ST1",
    st2    = "ST2",
    st3    = "ST3",
    st_all = "All ST"
  ) %>%
  set_caption("Recommended OOS R2: repo-held-out TWFE with repo demeaning and centered training month FE") %>%
  colformat_double(digits = 4) %>%
  autofit()

recommended_repo_holdout_twfe_delta <- recommended_repo_holdout_twfe_oos_r2 %>%
  mutate(
    target       = str_remove(target, "_t_plus_6"),
    delta_st1    = round(st1 - null, 4),
    delta_st2    = round(st2 - null, 4),
    delta_st3    = round(st3 - null, 4),
    delta_st_all = round(st_all - null, 4),
    null         = round(null, 4)
  ) %>%
  select(target, null, delta_st1, delta_st2, delta_st3, delta_st_all)

print(recommended_repo_holdout_twfe_delta)

flextable(recommended_repo_holdout_twfe_delta) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    target       = "Outcome",
    null         = "OOS R2 (Null)",
    delta_st1    = "Delta ST1",
    delta_st2    = "Delta ST2",
    delta_st3    = "Delta ST3",
    delta_st_all = "Delta All ST"
  ) %>%
  set_caption("Recommended incremental OOS R2 relative to the null model") %>%
  colformat_double(digits = 4) %>%
  autofit()

```
